items.stem: In ServiceNow, what is the recommended way to grant a set of users the same access?

options.text: Assign roles to a group and add the users to the group
options.rationale: Correct: roles are assigned to groups and inherited by members, which scales and is easier to maintain.

options.text: Assign each role to each user individually
options.rationale: Direct per-user role assignment is hard to maintain and error-prone.

options.text: Give every user the admin role
Add users to the sys_user table manually
options.rationale: Being a user record does not itself grant application access.

items.explanation: Correct: roles are assigned to groups and inherited by members, which scales and is easier to maintain.

items.stem: Which ServiceNow feature transforms imported data before it is written to a target table?

options.rationale: Correct: a transform map maps and transforms staged import-set rows into the target table.
Business rules run on database operations but are not the import mapping mechanism.
UI policies control form behaviour, not data import mapping.
ACLs enforce security, not import transformation.

items.stem: Which TWO objects can a notification be triggered by in ServiceNow?

options.text: A record being inserted or updated
options.rationale: Correct: notifications can be triggered by record insert/update conditions.
Correct: notifications can be triggered by events in the event queue.

options.text: A report being exported to PDF
options.rationale: Exporting a report does not trigger notifications.
Logout is not a standard notification trigger.
Viewing a dashboard does not trigger notifications.

items.explanation: Correct: notifications can be triggered by record insert/update conditions.
